Std ratio Combined/Real from 0.76 (Informational_Duration) to 1.10 (ProductRelated_Duration): spread is lowered in sparse columns and raised in browsing columns.

Effect of the Combined dataset: KS to Real above 0.05 in 2 of 14 columns (above 0.03 / 0.10: 6 / 0); mean KS 0.032; largest PageValues (0.068): about half the synthetic distance.

Effect of the Combined dataset: Mean |Δ Pearson| to Real 0.043 (max 0.15); 0 sign changes (|r| ≥ 0.1). Combined lies between Real and Synthetic for 84 of 91 Pearson pairs, not for all, because pooling two samples does not average correlations.

Real vs. Synthetic: PageValues outliers 22.4% real, 5.8% synthetic; synthetic maximum below the real maximum in 6 of 14 columns.
